hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); b=$(basename "$f"); [ "${f%.md}" != "$f" ] && [ -f "$f" ] && grep -qF '—' "$f" && printf '{"decision":"block","reason":"Em dash (—) détecté dans %s. Convention projet : utilisez - (tiret simple) uniquement."}' "$b" && exit 2; exit 0
